sources.quote:
## December 17, 2025

- Launched Gemini 3 Flash Preview, `gemini-3-flash-preview`, delivering fast
  frontier-class performance that rivals larger models at a fraction of the
  cost.
sources.supports: Google's changelog identifies the model's December 17, 2025 launch; it does not announce the tier that models.dev later recorded.

notes: The pre-commit May 1, 2026 Google pricing snapshot shows the same flat $0.50/$3.00/$0.05 rates as the current Google page, supporting that the >200,000-token tier was a models.dev metadata error rather than a provider price change. The sources do not establish the complete pricing history back to launch or an effective date; Internet Archive CDX requests returned HTTP 503, so no narrower historical bracket was available.
